title: Companion local account sign-out
description: Start on Settings, connected to a validation gateway with a service profile. The credential is not revoked; this device forgets its login. No person session is used.

sign-out.intent: Forget this device login through the real account control.

text_contains: Signed out. Log in or pair to choose an account.
signed-out.intent: Show that explicit login or pairing is required.

protocol.intent: Verify the live client lost its principal, HTTP authority and RPC transport.
